v0_1_clause.title: Multi-signal takeover detection + safe claim-confirmation
criteria: Multi-signal detection only — no single-fingerprint findings (a fingerprint match requires an independent NXDOMAIN or TLS-mismatch signal; pkg/engine, D2).
A working safe claim-confirmation for >=1 provider with mandatory release and blast-radius characterization (pkg/confirm + the GitHub Pages reference adapter, dry-run by default; D3/D8).
NS treated as a distinct critical class (rule=takeover.ns.<provider>, severity critical; pkg/engine/ns.go, D7).
The Packet-05 evidence invariant holds: no served-and-reflected canary, no `confirmed` (pkg/confirm.TestConfirm_EvidenceInvariant).
The precision guard holds: a fingerprint match with no independent signal is NOT detected (pkg/engine.TestFingerprintAloneIsNotDetected).
deferred_to_operator: Live claim execution: the live GitHub Pages adapter requires the operator's own credentials AND a wired GitHubOps client AND explicit authorization. graverobber does NOT perform a real provider registration autonomously (out-of-scope, irreversible, external-party exposure). See TAKEOVER.md.

Additional live claim adapters (S3, Heroku, Netlify, Vercel, Fastly) — the claim_adapter keys are registered in augment.json and the interface is ready; live implementations are a per-provider rotation lap, each proven against an owned dangling fixture.
NS zone-claim adapters — higher-risk; ship only where the provider supports clean create/delete.
